control: Enterprise step-up MFA / IdP validation for critical actions
summary: EuroComply step-up tokens remain signed_hmac tokens, but issuance now requires a real Supabase MFA aal2 verification or a fresh enterprise IdP claim. Tokens are scoped by userId, organizationId and action, contain a single-use nonce, expire within five minutes and are consumed through a server-side Supabase token store. Team invite, member removal, role change, invitation cancellation and security-settings management enforce the same step-up helper after RBAC and before writes. Enterprise release remains blocked when signing configuration, Supabase auth client configuration and a real MFA/IdP policy are not configured; the runtime preflight delegates to the same release gate and the production preflight executes that runtime preflight when enterprise release mode is enabled.
redactionConfirmation: All secrets, tokens, credentials, connection strings, and access-granting values are redacted.
controlsVerified: Token issuance requires Supabase MFA aal2 or configured enterprise IdP ACR/AMR claims.
Tokens are scoped by userId, organizationId and high-risk action.
Tokens include server-generated nonce, issuedAt, expiresAt and verificationMethod fields.
Tokens expire within five minutes and are consumed once from the server-side token store.
Critical routes reject missing, expired, replayed, cross-organization and cross-action tokens.
Team invite, team member removal, team role change and invitation cancellation require manage_team step-up after RBAC and before writes.
Team role changes block self-change, non-owner owner grants/removals and last-owner demotion.
Security-settings changes require manage_settings RBAC plus change_security_settings step-up before settings upsert.
Team UI uses the shared StepUpMfaDialog and sends x-eurocomply-step-up-token only to fixed protected API endpoints.
Enterprise release gate fails closed when signing configuration, Supabase auth client configuration or real provider configuration is missing.
Enterprise IdP release mode requires Supabase auth client configuration plus at least one non-empty ACR/AMR policy value after trimming.
Runtime provider preflight delegates to the enterprise release gate and never prints secret values.
Production preflight runs the runtime provider preflight when EUROCOMPLY_ENTERPRISE_RELEASE=true.

runtimeChecks: Supabase auth client configuration is present for session validation
supabase.auth.mfa.verify or challengeAndVerify validates the submitted code
supabase.auth.mfa.getAuthenticatorAssuranceLevel must return aal2 before token issuance
Supabase auth client configuration is present for session claim validation
auth_time or iat must be fresh within STEP_UP_MAX_AGE_MS
acr must match STEP_UP_IDP_ACR_VALUES or amr must match STEP_UP_IDP_AMR_VALUES
ACR/AMR allowlists are trimmed and whitespace-only values are treated as missing
enterprise_idp.tokenIssuedOnlyAfter: fresh strong IdP reauthentication claim is present

requires: Supabase auth client configuration for all provider modes
Non-empty enterprise IdP ACR/AMR policy when STEP_UP_PROVIDER_MODE=enterprise_idp

limitations: This repository evidence validates implementation wiring and fail-closed behavior. Live provider execution must be run in an environment with real Supabase MFA or enterprise IdP credentials configured.
